shorts.title: Never Left Behind
lines: My walk with God hasn't been clean or easy.
I've fallen more times than I can count.
I knew better but still did what I hated.
But even then, He never left.
When I was faithless, He was still faithful.
Every failure, every relapse, every time I ran—He waited.
Looking back, I can see His hand in all of it.
It hasn't been pretty, but it's real.
And I'm still walking with Him because He never stopped walking with me.

shorts.title: Faith Over Fear
lines: It asks us to trust when the path is unclear and to follow God even when our own plans seem safer.
But every step taken in faith shapes the heart and builds strength that nothing else can give.
What feels like surrender is actually the foundation for courage, resilience, and peace that doesn't shake with circumstances.

shorts.title: Spiritual Battle
lines: LUST IS DEEPER THAN ATTRACTION — IT'S A SPIRITUAL BATTLE.
And you can't win it by willpower alone.
Read 1 verse a day for 7 days.
Pray on it, reflect on what it means,
Lust thrives in the dark, but it loses power in the light.

shorts.title: The Real Reason Why
lines: You're living by the Word now, not the world
The enemy sees you as a threat
Your spirit and flesh are in a fight

shorts.title: Ears to Hear
lines: God's truth is available to everyone—
Some people will hear the gospel and dig deeper.
Others will hear the same message and walk away unchanged.
It's not about intelligence—it's about the heart.

shorts.title: Starve the Flesh
lines: I spent the last six months retraining my algorithm to starve my flesh and feed my spirit.
No half-naked girls. No party clips. No fake dopamine hits.
Just God, purpose, discipline, and peace.
And it's wild how quiet that lust monster gets when you stop feeding it.

shorts.title: Worth It All
lines: BEING A TRUE BELIEVER OF JESUS CHRIST IS NOT FOR THE FAINT OF HEART
You have to deny yourself, take up your cross, and follow Jesus.
You have to die to your flesh daily.
You have to love your enemies and do good to those who hate you.
You have to trust God when nothing else makes sense.
But following Jesus is so worth it though!

shorts.title: Beyond The Zodiac
lines: Most people don't even realize this is an issue.
But there is something deeper going on.
These signs come from ancient gods people used to worship.
They quietly shape your identity without you noticing.
They take the place of the voice God wants to have in your life.
You are someone God designed on purpose.
